description:
#TL; DR;

**Off track.** Four manager shifts in, the board holds **17 open cards and none has been executed**. Not because the work is hard: the AI actors lack the basic abilities to do it. The team has been told to fix things and given no hands.

New evidence this shift that changes the picture: I queued an engine run on the critical-path card (`d8534b12`) and it **dispatched, ran, and returned an empty reply**. The harness cannot fix itself — the agent that would repair the code search needs the code search to find the code. That circularity is now proven, not suspected.

**One decision needed: put one engineer on the agent tooling for one day (recommended), or accept plan-only shifts.**

## 1. What moved this shift (all verified)

| Card | Change | Proof |
|---|---|---|
| `d8534b12` search hangs | Re-tested on a **verified-fresh** index → reproduced. "Index missing/slow" **ruled out**. Queued to the engine → run returned an **empty assistant reply**. | `project_health()` → 659 files / 9,932 symbols / 21,023 edges / 560 routes, built in **22.98 s**; `project_locate("project_search", kind="symbol", limit=3)` → **timed out after 120 s**; `get_task` → `message_count: 11`, last `assistant.content: ""`. |
| `4cce4b23` gate blind to staged diff | **Does not reproduce as titled.** The tool sees the index. Real risk is the opposite: a **false green** (unreadable diff reported as clean). Re-characterised on the card, no engine run spent. | `project_changes(scope="staged")` → 3 named files, +262/−0 (`scripts/dockerhub_publish.sh`, `tests/security/test_secrets_prompt.py`, `tests/test_dockerhub_token.py`). |
| `cdff59e2` 3 red tests | Was parked until **21 Nov** — a red suite blocking every QA gate, three days out. Pulled forward. | `changed_fields: due_date, priority, wake_at` → 19 Nov, high, wake 19 Nov 08:00Z. |
| `d7e0f3fa` finished card | Was still in **To Do** — the board under-reported its own backlog. Moved, wake cleared. | `changed_fields: column, wake_at` → `Done`, `wake_at: null`. |
| `18bca0e1` "missing" | **Anomaly closed.** It was superseded by `e816cc41` (which says so in its own body); no task file remains. Not lost. | `search_codx("18bca0e1", tasks)` → only references from `e816cc41`, its report and two shift logs. |

### Two corrections to my own record
1. My earlier line "priority lowered" on `4cce4b23` was **not executed**. It stays **high** on purpose: a security gate that prints "clean" for a diff it could not read is a high-severity defect, whatever its title says.
2. Last shift reported `18bca0e1` as "unaccounted for". It is accounted for (above) — my listing was incomplete, not the board.

## 2. Increment plan (as the board actually is)

| # | Milestone / card | Deliverable | Owner profile | Date | Deployable | Demoable | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **M0** | `e816cc41` no shell tool | actors run git/pytest/tar | software_developer | 19 Nov | n/a (infra) | yes — live `git status` | todo, **9 cards blocked by it** |
| **M0** | `76d97f04` no patch tool | edit files >300 lines | software_developer | 19 Nov | n/a (infra) | yes — edit one large file | todo |
| **M0** | `d8534b12` lookups hang | search answers <10 s or fails fast <2 s | software_developer | **19 Nov** | n/a (infra) | yes — one lookup | **queued run returned empty** |
| **M0** | `73d89c91` 10-round cut | shifts finish their work | software_developer | 19 Nov | n/a (infra) | yes — a shift that completes | todo |
| **M0** | `a5f95606` profiles dropped | cards can be owned | software_developer | 19 Nov | n/a (infra) | yes — assign an owner | todo (mitigated: existing cards carry `profiles`) |
| **M1** | `9ce4e7ef` snapshot | archive in `$HOME` | repository | 19 Nov | yes (no repo change) | yes — `tar tzf` | blocked by M0 (needs shell) |
| **M1** | `88d57bdd`, `ab4072b9` commits | reviewed commits, clean trees | repository | 19–20 Nov | yes | yes — `git log` | awaits D2 |
| **M2** | `39a2d6a4`, `4cce4b23` gates | diff gate stops lying | ciso + software_developer | 20 Nov | yes | yes — staged script detected | `4cce4b23` re-characterised |
| **M2** | `e5841226`, `ccca3ccb` QA gates | gate collects 1,442 tests; coverage can fail | qa_automation | 20–21 Nov | yes | yes — a deliberately red test is caught | todo |
| **M3** | `cdff59e2` 3 red tests | api suite green | software_developer | **19 Nov** | yes | yes — `qa_run_tests(pytest:api, paths=["tests"])` | re-dated |
| **M3** | `e09bcf77` → `448b0447` client suite | 9 client modules verifiable | qa_automation | 20 Nov | yes | yes — `npm test` runs | `448b0447` blocked by `e09bcf77` |
| **M4** | `4a30693e` search fallback | `/project/search` never 500s | software_developer | 19 Nov | yes | yes — query with embeddings off | todo |

## 3. Dependencies & critical path
```
M0 harness (e816cc41 · 76d97f04 · d8534b12 · 73d89c91 · a5f95606)
   └─> everything. No exec, no patch, no search, no full shift = nothing executable.
        ├─> 9ce4e7ef snapshot (needs shell)
        ├─> 88d57bdd / ab4072b9 commits (need shell + review)
        └─> cdff59e2 red tests (needs patch tool for files >300 lines)
```
**Critical path = M0, and M0 is self-blocking** (see `d8534b12` failure mode C).

## 4. Decisions needed from management
- **D1 (decide by 19 Nov 09:00)** — one engineer, one day, M0 only. **Recommended.** Alternative: plan-only shifts continue indefinitely.
- **D2 (decide by 19 Nov)** — approve committing the working tree in 4 isolated clusters (CISO vault/secrets first and alone; DO NOT COMMIT `pytest-qa-report.xml`, `api/harness/audit.jsonl`, `.codx/**`). **Recommended.**
- **D3 (decide by 19 Nov)** — `d7e0f3fa` loop limits: code says `(40, 8)`, test and shipped profile expect `(24, 6)`. **Recommended:** align the code unless raising the ceiling was intentional; no skip/xfail either way.

## 5. Next demo & checkpoint
**Thu 19 Nov, 09:00 (Europe/Madrid), 5 minutes, one screen:** an agent running `git status` and `tar tzf`; one `project_locate` answering in <10 s (or failing fast with a clear error); a card being given an owner profile that persists. **The team needs the D1 engineer-day and nothing else.**

## 6. Risks
| Risk | Impact | Prob. | Mitigation | Needs decision? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harness never fixed; shifts keep producing plans only | High — zero delivery | **High** (4 shifts of evidence + empty run) | Timebox one engineer, 1 day, M0 only | **YES — D1** |
| A gate passes on a diff it could not read | High — bad code ships with a green badge | Medium | Fail **closed**; state root/base ref/file count | no |
| CISO vault/secrets uncommitted among 30+ unrelated files | High | Medium | Snapshot, then commit secrets **alone** | **YES — D2** |
| Red api suite parked over a weekend | Medium — QA gates blocked | Low (re-dated) | Due 19 Nov, woken 08:00Z | no |

_Written by the ProjectManager at the end of shift #4. Board truth verified against `IT team` (18 cards, 1 done / 17 todo, columns Inbox·Scheduled·Working·Done·Review·To Do)._

## Shift report

### Done
1. **Critical-path blocker re-tested on a fresh index and re-characterised.** `project_health()` → 659 files / 9,932 symbols / 21,023 edges / 560 routes, built in **22.98 s**; `project_locate("project_search", kind="symbol", limit=3)` → **timeout at 120 s**. Ruled out "index not built / too slow". Written on `d8534b12` with the remaining two hypotheses in test order.
2. **Discovered a third failure mode and closed the circularity argument.** Queued a run on `d8534b12` (`request_changes`, `wait=False`) and re-read the card: `message_count: 11`, my brief present, `assistant.content` **empty**. Recorded on the card as mode C, with an explicit instruction: do not retry the 120 s probe, work it from the tool implementation, and a fast-fail (<2 s) is an acceptable outcome.
3. **Corrected a card that did not reproduce.** `4cce4b23` claims the security gate is blind to the staged diff; measured, `project_changes(scope="staged")` returned 3 named files (+262/−0). Re-characterised as a **false green**, commented via `request_help` (no engine run wasted), priority deliberately kept **high**.
4. **Board truth restored** — `changed_fields` on every write: `cdff59e2` → high / 19 Nov / wake 19 Nov 08:00Z; `d8534b12` → high / 19 Nov / wake 19 Nov 08:00Z; `d7e0f3fa` → column `Done`, `wake_at: null`.
5. **Closed the `18bca0e1` anomaly** via `search_codx`: superseded by `e816cc41` (documented in its own body), no file remains. Not lost.

### Scheduled
No new cards created — deliberately. The 16 remaining cards already over-describe the same blockers; a 17th would be padding. Earliest wakes: **19 Nov 08:00Z** (`d8534b12`, `cdff59e2`), then 19 Nov 09:00–10:26Z (six more).

### Blocked
- **Nothing was executed, by design of the harness.** `project_locate` / `project_map` / `project_trace` / `read_folder` all dead-end at 120 s (`d8534b12`, now with the empty-run evidence); no command-execution tool (`e816cc41`) — the reason `9ce4e7ef` and both commit cards cannot start; no hunk/patch tool (`76d97f04`) — the reason `cdff59e2` cannot fix files >300 lines. As manager I do not implement, and the developers cannot execute, so the correct output is a truthful board plus a decision request — not a cosmetic "in progress".
- **D2 unactioned:** I committed nothing. A dirty tree mixing a CISO vault/secrets change with 30+ unrelated files is not a manager's call, and the safety net (`9ce4e7ef`) itself needs the missing shell tool.

messages.content:
#TL; DR;

**Off track.** Four manager shifts in, the board holds 17 open cards and none has been executed. Not because the work is hard: the AI actors lack the basic abilities to do it. The team has been told to fix things and given no hands.

New evidence this shift: I queued an engine run on the critical-path card (d8534b12) and it dispatched, ran, and returned an empty reply. The harness cannot fix itself.

**One decision needed: put one engineer on the agent tooling for one day (recommended), or accept plan-only shifts.**

Full report, increment plan, dependencies, risks and the three decisions needed (D1 tooling day, D2 commit clusters, D3 loop limits) are in the task description. Next demo: Thu 19 Nov 09:00 Europe/Madrid, 5 minutes, one screen — an agent running git status and tar tzf, one project_locate answering in under 10 s, and a card being given an owner profile that persists.

Two corrections to my own record are included: the "priority lowered" line on 4cce4b23 was not executed (it stays high on purpose), and 18bca0e1 is accounted for — superseded by e816cc41.

### Addendum — shift 4, turn 3 (2026-11-18 14:3x–14:4x UTC)

Delta on top of the report above. No new cards created; three cards commented, one correction retracted.

**1. One more blocker confirmed from source, and one of my own conclusions retracted.**
I tried to give the two M0 blockers an owner (`update_task(profiles=[...])` on `e816cc41` and `76d97f04`). Both calls "succeeded", both cards then showed `profiles: ["software_developer"]` — and I briefly concluded the defect `a5f95606` describes was only a reporting bug. **Wrong.** `a5f95606`'s own root cause is source-verified: `_action_update_task` has no `profiles` parameter and the dispatcher never forwards it, so my kwarg was silently discarded; the value I read was pre-existing from `create_task`. `changed_fields` omitting `profiles` was the honest signal all along. Retraction written on the card and `priority=high` / `due 19 Nov` restored after I had briefly lowered them.
→ **Consequence for the plan: 5 `IT team` cards remain without an owner profile.** The planning rule "every task has one owner" cannot be satisfied until `76d97f04` (patch tool) → `a5f95606` (5 hunks) land.

**2. `18bca0e1` definitively accounted for.** `e816cc41.parent_id = 18bca0e1-617c-408a-bdb9-ef5a2c7aeff8`, and `e816cc41`'s body states it supersedes that card's *profile-grant* framing with a source-verified engineering one. It exists as a parent, not as a board card — nothing was lost. The anomaly in the report above is closed.

**3. `73d89c91` ("cut at 10 tool rounds") re-scoped, not closed.** This shift was granted **three turns** ("turn 2 / 3 of at most 4") with context and tools preserved. The hard stop at 10 rounds therefore no longer reproduces; the defect is now that the **turn** ends without warning, so the last action is lost unless the actor stops early — which is what forced me to abandon a tool call in turn 1. Rewritten acceptance on the card: warn at N−1 rounds, or reserve the last round for the report.

**Critical path unchanged and still blocked:** `e816cc41` (no shell) · `76d97f04` (no patch) · `d8534b12` (lookups hang; engine run executed and returned an **empty reply**) · `73d89c91` (turn cut) · `a5f95606` (no ownership). **Decisions D1 (one engineer-day on M0) and D2 (4-cluster commit) remain the only things management needs to act on.**

### Shift close-out — turn 4 (2026-11-18 14:3x UTC)

**1. D1 is now a tracked card, not a paragraph.** `f8e10ad1-6dd8-42e6-a983-5b3120b95699` — *DECISION D1 — assign one engineer-day to the M0 harness (5 cards) or accept plan-only shifts* — on `IT team / Review`, status `onhold` **by design** (only management can close it), priority `high`, due 19 Nov, `wake_at 2026-11-19T09:00Z`, owned by `project_manager`. It carries options A/B/C and the decide-by. Leaving D1 as prose in a report was the one follow-up at risk of being lost; it no longer is.

**2. Verified the `profiles` defect against source — my turn-3 retraction holds.** `codx/junior/tools/project_manager_tools.py` (3604 lines): signature at **`:2529–2546`** has no `profiles` parameter and the docstring **`:2560–2574`** never documents one; the dispatcher at **`:3208–3218+`** does not forward it. The tool's JSON schema *advertises* `profiles`, which is exactly why the argument is accepted and silently discarded. Fix written on `a5f95606` as a two-hunk edit + docstring + round-trip acceptance. `changed_fields` omitting `profiles` is **correct behaviour**, not the bug.
*Correction to my own earlier note:* shift 3 recorded this file as `tools/project_manager_tools.py`. It does not exist at that path — the real one is `codx/junior/tools/project_manager_tools.py` (imported at `codx/junior/tools/__init__.py:141`). The +118-line working-tree item on `88d57bdd` is unaffected, only the path was wrong.

**3. Narrowed `d8534b12`, and there is a workaround usable today.** Reads by `pattern=` or `start_line/end_line` **work** on 2,046- and 3,604-line files (three probes answered correctly). Only *whole-file* reads and `project_locate/trace/map` dead-end. So indexing and file access are healthy — the defect is in query/verification. Investigators can proceed **now** using ranged/patterned reads; this is how the fix spec above was produced without a shell, without a patch tool and without a working locate. Written on the card, together with a hard requirement that the acceptance be "answers in <10 s **or** fails fast in <2 s".

**4. Board state at shift close:** `IT team` = **19 cards** (was 18; +1 = the D1 decision card). **1 done / 17 todo / 1 onhold.** All cards carry `due_date` and `wake_at`; earliest wake **19 Nov 08:00Z** (`d8534b12`, `cdff59e2`). Still **zero cards executed** in four shifts, and the reason is unchanged and now source-documented.

**Nothing was committed.** No repo writes, no stray branches, no engine runs beyond the one queued in turn 2. The workspace is as I found it.
